description: Urban Waste Water Treatment Plant Locations is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Protection Agency. This is a point dataset of the waste water treatment plants in agglomerations (towns/cities) with a population equivalent of over 500 during 2006, 2007 and 2008, and were reported on and assessed for compliance under The Urban Waste Water Treatment Regulations, 2001 (S.I. No. 254 of 2001) and 2004 (S.I. 440 of 2004). Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Protection Agency. Its tags are environment, government, ie, industrial waste, plant locations. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
